mdc-commission.clerkAddress: Clerk of the Board, Stephen P. Clark Center, 111 NW 1st St, Suite 17-202, Miami, FL 33128
mdc-commission.notes: All emails on miamidade.gov are Cloudflare-protected; each was decoded from the page's email-protection link and the decode was verified locally (XOR with first byte). Case of district emails is as the page encodes it. No district page lists office hours except District 6's Hialeah satellite and mobile hours. Chief of staff appears only on the contact-us pages of Districts 1, 5, 7 and 13; the other contact-us pages list only the commissioner. Clerk of the Board pages list no email ("contact this office by phone or in writing"); cocpubreq@miamidadeclerk.gov is the Clerk's public records email from the public-records-requests page, which also directs BCC records requests to the county GovQA portal (select Board of County Commission) and gives (305) 593-1352 for questions. No written-comment email found on the commission pages; written comment route not confirmed. Mayor row is included here because mdc-mayor is a one-office body.
